title: 日本ダービーの後に・まだ蕾にて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The promised race, the Derby, is over. Sakura Chiyono O has failed to win. The pain is keen as she strikes the turf, devastated over her loss.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Still, she hasn't lost sight of her goal of becoming stronger and one day running with Maruzensky. Sakura Chiyono O wipes away her tears and stands back up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky watches her from the stands with a satisfied smile, resolving to fulfill her final promise with Sakura Chiyono O.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O's growth and newfound strength are thanks to her rivals. As she stands there, hoping she can keep running forever…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan suddenly collapses. She's been pushing her legs so far to the extreme, they give out underneath her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan is ready to leave the racing world behind, but Sakura Chiyono O swears that as her rival, she'll make Ardan regret leaving so much she comes back.
